onboarding.title: How Unfeed works
onboarding.login: You sign in to TikTok inside the app. Unfeed never sees or stores your password.
onboarding.how: Unfeed opens each video and removes the like, favorite or repost for you, just like you would, at a human pace.
onboarding.device: Everything happens on your phone. Keep the app open while it cleans; the screen won't turn off.
onboarding.risk: TikTok has no official feature for this. If it sees a lot of activity it may ask you to verify or limit actions for a while. Unfeed goes slowly and stops if that happens.
onboarding.googleTitle: Do you sign in with Google or Apple?
onboarding.google: Google and Apple don't allow signing in inside other apps. Add an email or phone number to your TikTok account, or use the QR code from another device.

login.title: Sign in to TikTok
login.hint: Use your email, phone or username. Google and Apple don't work here.

clean.quotaEmpty: You've used today's {{limit}} removals. Come back tomorrow.
clean.choose: What do you want to clean?
clean.dryRun: Test mode: nothing will be removed

progress.resting: Short break so TikTok doesn't get suspicious
progress.keepOpen: Keep the app open. The screen won't turn off.
progress.notLoggedIn: You're not signed in to TikTok.

summary.completed: Done! There's nothing left to clean.
summary.stopped: You stopped the cleaning. You can continue any time.
summary.daily_limit: You reached today's limit. Continue tomorrow where you left off.
summary.captcha: TikTok asked for a verification. Wait a while and try again.
summary.rate_limit: TikTok is limiting actions. Wait a few hours before continuing.
summary.logged_out: Your TikTok session ended. Please sign in again.
summary.too_many_failures: Something failed several times in a row. Try again later.
summary.dryRun: Test mode: nothing was actually removed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.speedHint: Careful speed is slower and lowers the chance of TikTok limiting your account.
settings.privacyText: Unfeed has no servers that receive your data. Your TikTok session and progress are stored only on this phone, and we never see your password.
